personalityContract.application: At every NPC speech and visible reaction, select saved focus-trait line plus concise context-compatible cues drawn from all five traits. All-five rendering follows installed revision6 personality contract; do not stack five canned action sentences. Affinity/actual knowledge modulate distance and recalled cause, never overwrite traits. Outcome chosen only by engine. Player lines/choices are intentions, not NPC-generated personality.
personalityContract.precedence: Installed recurring conversation revision6 retains its exact pending lines/actions/receipts. This coverage is for stage-specific new scenes or explicit fallback only. A newly numeric stage never silently replaces a pending conversation. Archived voiceVariants do not execute.
personalityContract.noUnchosenContact: No default cheek/nose/coat contact or grooming from numeric affinity alone. Offer appropriate player intent under actual eligibility; do not force the player’s feelings or a hidden promise.
personalityContract.persist: Save actual NPC identity, trait snapshot/version, selected speechId/band/action, node and offered choices. Continue displays same line, not a rerolled personality.

runtimeContract.authority: Semantic authoring schema only; Flint maps IDs/results to real engine APIs. Tundra spec and formulas own numerical gates/costs/rolls. No invented balance adjustment to force a successful run.
runtimeContract.bond: Met→acquainted≥15→close≥25 require actual chosen beats. Court requires close beat, adult/elder, attraction, kin and unpaired gates, correct window/cadence. A numeric value alone grants neither consent, crush nor mates. Accepted courtship expresses willingness only until all stable-bond/pride approval/rival conditions commit.
runtimeContract.prideOrigin: Leader approval type(a) and actual qualifying non-lethal rival required only where specified. Approval never transfers ownership of a cat, substitutes consent, sets a feud ruling or automatically teaches an absent leader.
runtimeContract.commit: At mate confirmation, actual reciprocal mate IDs/stage and mate_secured milestone commit once. Found commits actual legal region, pride/den/claim/membership once; pending acknowledgement never replicates +20 origin standing or source receipts.
runtimeContract.costs: Use current spec §3 actions, gate checks and originating-day budget exactly. Court meeting choice consumes no second day; Court-as-action Energy -5. Seek out same home zone -5 or legal one-day Travel -15; no same-day hunt. Found after day20 legal with existing mate; illegal Found and forced out-of-window Court reject atomically. Preserve affordable/free exits and earlier resource fixes.
runtimeContract.continuation: mate_secured and pride_founded are NONTERMINAL. Season_end occurs once after day20 chains resolve/lapse, then day21 actions continue. Mated results Continue only; unmated-without-pride three route-intent buttons each continue without locking route, charging a day, granting membership or creating groups. No new-run ending, time skip, year length, later season name or breeding.
runtimeContract.knowledge: Use actual participants/witnesses and explicit relays. Stage/proximity/affinity is not knowledge of a specific quiet walk, kill, promise, political dispute or approval. Never narrate leader knowledge from pride standing alone.
runtimeContract.day20: Resolve existing same-day chain or lapse per spec §4; no pending court/approval/rival rolls survive as a fresh day21 mate bond. Existing mate may Found later. Dead mate stays dead; historical milestone is not live mate state.
runtimeContract.save: Persist full stage, gates, attempt/cooldown receipts, chosen variants, cast/knowledge, reciprocal bond, origin membership, founding record, seasonEndShown and routeIntent. Save/Continue before/after each commit cannot reroll, redeliver, duplicate reward, lose a Continue button or resurrect a completed chain.
runtimeContract.groups: route_group intent promises no immediate group. Actual eligible saved group capacity/relationships/roll/membership remain required; mixed-sex eligibility is proposed per spec, not approved by narrative.
runtimeContract.allModes: Offline authored beats and online/local narration share exact state, eligibility, consent, knowledge and outcome constraints; no generated mechanics or free-text unlock implied.
